name: claude-starters
description: Token-lean project starters, on-demand clean-code skills, a scoped 76-agent library, and a cost-aware auto-launch orchestrator for Claude Code.

suggest_on_existing_repos.title: Offer a starter in existing repos
suggest_on_existing_repos.description: On session start, if the repo has a recognizable stack and no starter applied, offer to apply one. Asked once per repo, never writes to the repo. Leave unset for on.

turn_end_orchestrator.title: Surface specialist agents at turn end
turn_end_orchestrator.description: After each turn, scan the working-tree diff for risk patterns tied to your stack and surface matching specialist agents. Deterministic, no model call. Leave unset for on.
